summary: NDR feed s151_double is degraded: 8.9% duplicate packets (168/1885) and 2.0% TCP packet loss (36/1845) detected. No one-way, VLAN, encryption or tool overload issues. Deduplication and lossless capture fixes needed to restore full detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Same packets delivered twice - likely two SPAN/mirror sources carrying the same flows aggregated without deduplication, or packet broker forwarding the same traffic via dual paths to the NDR port.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR wastes CPU/storage on 8.9% duplicate traffic, inflates flow/byte counts, misinterprets duplicates as retransmissions and degrades detection/analytics accuracy.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication window to drop identical packets arriving within milliseconds before delivery to NDR, removing duplicate load while preserving unique traffic.

findings.root_cause: Upstream loss before the NDR - SPAN/mirror buffer overflow or packet broker egress oversubscription dropping packets (tool_overload is healthy, so loss is not at NDR ingress).
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR with needs_full_payload=true and needs_both_directions=true cannot reassemble TCP streams with gaps; causes missed payload inspection, broken file extraction and missed detections.

recommended_fix.why: Replace lossy SPAN/mirror with passive TAP and ensure packet broker has adequate buffering/bandwidth for lossless delivery; TAP does not drop under load like SPAN buffers do.
